title: Alioth
imageAlt: Alioth with dark hair, blue armor and blue gemstone jewelry
dek: A reader who turns curiosity into expeditions, approaches institutions through conversation and chooses loyalty to Casimir even when it costs admission to the Rahu.
body:
Alioth wants to see what lies beyond the books she loves. She gathers companions, asks how to approach unfamiliar people and brings gifts when conversation might open a door. Curiosity and social confidence coexist with doubt, attachment and the need to look after others.

From reading to an embassy visit

In August 2024, Alioth asks Lucido who the Rahu are and proposes going to see their embassy. She gathers companions and suggests a gift and a performance as ways to gain an audience. She is candid with her companions that the courtesy is also a means of getting inside.

When the guide slips away, reading becomes practical knowledge. The narrator credits her familiarity with local papers and stories with knowing the route. She finds an opening to speak to the guard captain and presents the company as visitors offering thanks, entertainment and a gift. The social approach gains an opportunity to speak; it does not prove that every claim in the presentation is candid or every Rahu practice understood.

Courtesy alongside uncertainty

On a later visit, Alioth and Casimir bring a gift together. She seeks time with the duchess and coordinates conversation with Eugene and Casimir. Her ease with formal address does not remove her unease: she squeezes Casimir’s hand while worrying that the journey may not go as they hope.

The courtly introductions belong to that encounter. They do not independently establish permanent noble offices for everyone introduced or guarantee that the diplomatic plans succeed.

A loyalty the Rahu refuse

Alioth and Casimir choose each other during the Rahu trial. Ephraith declares that they have put each other before the Rahu and failed. Casimir accepts the consequences; Alioth answers that their loyalty is a strength and challenges the queen’s interpretation.

The refusal remains an institutional outcome, and Alioth’s answer remains her conviction. Neither has to erase the other. The shared history preserves the competing meanings without merging the two people into one voice.

Care while the expedition continues

After the disrupted concert, Alioth moves among companions offering healing and checks on Casimir last. In the later shadowed passage, she worries about him falling, checks on Binulette and asks about healing the injured. Silence limits what the group can safely attempt.

She offers to scatter footprints and writes in the stone when the company needs another way to communicate. Her later need for Casimir’s hand gives the partnership another scale: beside grand declarations of loyalty are immediate acts of comfort, practical help and shared uncertainty.

The unfinished history

These scenes establish initiative, reading, diplomatic attempts, the failed trial and continued expedition work. They do not provide a complete early life, permanent civic rank or final fate. Her independent history remains linked to Casimir without assigning his judgments to her.

    Finding a route through reading

    Disagreeing with the verdict

    Alioth calls loyalty to Casimir a strength after Ephraith declares their trial unsuccessful.

    Known at this stage
    The refusal is already given; her reply challenges its meaning.
    Consequence
    Her commitment survives without rewriting the institutional result.
    Still unresolved

    Offering care after the concert

    Alioth moves among the company offering healing, then checks on Casimir.

    Known at this stage
    The fight has ended but the harm and practical aftermath remain.
    Consequence
    The record gives her a role beyond being the person Casimir protects.
    Still unresolved

    Practical help in a dangerous silence

    Alioth offers to conceal tracks and writes in stone while the company needs silence.

    Known at this stage
    The group is adapting to a dangerous passage rather than following a fully understood route.
    Consequence
    She contributes to their shared methods while accepting comfort from Casimir.
    Still unresolved
